📱 Simulator Controls

1
Unlock Screen: Tap the lock screen prompt or click the physical power button on the top-right side.
2
Auto Onboarding: Upon unlock, a virtual pointer automatically selects and opens the Videos app.
3
Interactive Gallery: Scroll the photos list. Hover plays preview. Single-click selects, and Double-Click opens TikTok full view.
4
TikTok/Reels Mode: • Use [Arrow Up / Down] keys to slide between videos.
• [Double-Click] on video to like and pop red hearts!
• Controls on the remote D-pad can also navigate feeds.
